description: This file defines utility functions for creating runtime adapters and delegates for channel communication, including methods to resolve forwarded methods asynchronously and generate adapters for listing peers, groups, and sending messages.

methods.name: resolveForwardedMethod
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves a method from a runtime, throwing an error if unavailable.

methods.name: createRuntimeDirectoryLiveAdapter
methods.description: Creates an adapter with methods to list peers, groups, and group members, resolving the actual methods dynamically.

methods.name: createRuntimeOutboundDelegates
methods.description: Creates outbound message delegate functions (sendText, sendMedia, sendPoll) that resolve methods dynamically based on runtime.
